record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: Let Y1 be the Veronese double cone, i.e. the degree-6 hypersurface in the weighted projective space P(1,1,1,2,3). Is there a unique orbit, under the universal cover of GL_2^+(R), of Serre-invariant stability conditions on the Kuznetsov component Ku(Y1)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Y_1$ denote the Veronese double cone, i.e. a smooth degree-$6$ hypersurface in the weighted projective space $\mathbb{P}(1,1,1,2,3)$. Consider its bounded derived category $D^b(Y_1)$ and the associated Kuznetsov component
$$\mathrm{Ku}(Y_1) = \{ E \in D^b(Y_1) : \mathrm{Ext}^\bullet(\mathcal{O}_{Y_1}, E) = 0 \},$$
which is a triangulated subcategory admitting a Serre functor $S_{\mathrm{Ku}(Y_1)}$. A Bridgeland stability condition $\sigma$ on $\mathrm{Ku}(Y_1)$ is called Serre-invariant if $S_{\mathrm{Ku}(Y_1)} \cdot \sigma = g \cdot \sigma$ for some element $g$ of the universal cover $\widetilde{\mathrm{GL}}_2^+(\mathbb{R})$ acting on the space of stability conditions in the standard way.

Question: Is there a unique orbit, under the action of $\widetilde{\mathrm{GL}}_2^+(\mathbb{R})$, of Serre-invariant Bridgeland stability conditions on $\mathrm{Ku}(Y_1)$?
artifact.status_search_result: The Veronese double cone case is known to behave differently from the cubic threefold (where uniqueness of the orbit of Serre-invariant stability conditions has been established). Existing work on the Kuznetsov component of the Veronese double cone (notably Petković–Rota) studies moduli of stable objects but does not establish uniqueness of the orbit of Serre-invariant stability conditions; the question is stated as an open problem in recent surveys on categorical Torelli theorems, with no published resolution found.

status_evidence.title: A note on the Kuznetsov component of the Veronese double cone
status_evidence.snippet: Studies moduli spaces of stable complexes in Ku(Y) for a Veronese double cone; describes two components but does not resolve uniqueness of orbit of Serre-invariant stability conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Existing analysis of Ku(Y_1) does not prove uniqueness of orbit.

status_evidence.title: Serre-invariant stability conditions and Ulrich bundles on cubic threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: Provides a general criterion giving a unique Serre-invariant stability condition (up to universal cover of GL_2^+) for certain fractional Calabi-Yau categories, applied to cubic threefolds.
status_evidence.claim: Uniqueness criterion has been established for related cases (cubic threefolds) but not for Y_1.
